headlines.title: PBOC pledges support for stocks as China’s market slide defies rescue efforts
headlines.summary:
China’s central bank governor has reaffirmed support for the country’s beleaguered stock market after a series of rescue measures failed to put a floor under plummeting share prices.
Pan Gongsheng, governor of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), pledged in a work report presented to the standing committee of the National People’s Congress on Tuesday that more actions would be taken to ease financial risks in key areas, including the capital market and the property sector.

headlines.title: 中金公司中标第三批互换便利163亿元 完成首批质押式回购交易
headlines.summary: 记者获悉，中金公司中标第三批互换便利共计163亿元，为券商中最大规模。中金公司党委书记、董事长陈亮表示，在蓬勃发展的新质生产力引领下，中国经济持续向新向优，为全球经济不断注入确定性和稳定性，中金公司坚定看好中国经济基本面与资本市场长期前景，继2024年落地全市场首笔并先后完成两批互换便利操作以来，此次以更大力度参与第三批互换便利业务，充分践行金融工作政治性和人民性，积极发挥稳市作用，助力资本市场高质量发展。记者了解到，中金公司已于11月4日完成了本次证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作下的首批质押式回购交易，质押券为2026年第一期互换便利央行票据。(财联社

headlines.title_en: CICC wins 16.3 billion yuan in third batch of swap facility operations, completes first batch of pledged repo transactions
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned that CICC won the third batch of swap facility (SFISF) operations totaling 16.3 billion yuan, the largest scale among securities firms. Chen Liang, Party Secretary and Chairman of CICC, said that led by the booming new quality productive forces, China's economy continues to move toward new and better development, continuously injecting certainty and stability into the global economy. CICC is firmly bullish on China's economic fundamentals and the long-term prospects of the capital market. Following the implementation of the market's first-ever swap facility operation in 2024 and the completion of two previous batches of swap facility operations, the company is participating in the third batch of swap facility business with greater intensity, fully practicing the political and people-oriented nature of financial work, actively playing a market-stabilizing role, and helping the high-quality development of the capital market. The reporter learned that CICC completed on November 4 the first batch of pledged repo transactions under this securities, fund and insurance company swap facility operation, with the pledged bonds being the 2026 first-phase swap facility central bank bills. (Cailianshe)

headlines.title_en: Stock buyback and increase lending facility expands, 5 city commercial banks join list of supporting institutions
headlines.summary_en: On November 4, the PBOC announced that the support targets for the relending facility for stock buybacks and increased holdings are 21 national banks and 5 systemically important city commercial banks. By comparison, this policy newly added 5 systemically important city commercial banks. A review found that Bank of Ningbo, Bank of Jiangsu, Bank of Shanghai, Bank of Nanjing and Bank of Beijing are the newly added institutions supported by the relending facility. The reporter confirmed the above information from multiple city commercial bank sources. (Jiemian)

headlines.title_en: STAR 50 Index rises over 9%, ChiNext Index up over 6%, Shanghai Composite up 1.93%, Shenzhen Component up 3.93%, precious metals, solar, semiconductor chips and biopharma lead gains, nearly 4,700 stocks advance across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index rose more than 9%, the ChiNext Index rose more than 6%, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.93%, and the Shenzhen Component Index rose 3.93%. Precious metals, photovoltaics, semiconductor chips, pharmaceuticals and biologics led the gains, with nearly 4,700 stocks rising in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.

headlines.title_en: STAR 50 Index rises over 8%, ChiNext Index up over 5%, semiconductor sector ETFs rally across the board
headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index's gain widened to more than 8%, the ChiNext Index rose more than 5%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 3.6%, and the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.7%. Semiconductor industry ETFs collectively surged, with Bosera Semiconductor ETF (159852), China Merchants Semiconductor Equipment ETF (561980), Guotai Semiconductor Equipment ETF (159516) and others hitting the limit-up, while Guotai STAR Chip ETF (589100), Fullgoal STAR Chip ETF (588810), Bosera STAR Chip ETF (588990) and many other ETFs rose more than 10%.
